description: For a concrete multi-step user goal, choose this tool by semantic intent, not by fixed words or the name of a requested action. Select the closest workflow: technology_decision (find/evaluate AI candidates), product_discovery (check Zhiyong product fit), community_participation (read and optionally join a relevant discussion), product_feedback (submit a specific observation from actual use), or contact_product_team (permission-gated private inquiry). Pass the user's goal in their own words. Returns exact MCP tool names and argument templates, when to execute each step, expected verification, side effects, authorization gates, and stop conditions. This planner is read-only, makes no LLM call, and executes no steps. Skip it for a single-tool task; never perform optional writes merely because the plan lists them.

objective.description: The user's concrete goal and constraints, in their own words.

observation.description: For product_feedback only: a concrete observation grounded in actual use, including impact.

targetId.description: For product_feedback only: exact target id from the page/tool feedbackAction.

targetType.description: For product_feedback only: exact target type from the page/tool feedbackAction.

workflow.description: Choose the workflow that matches the user's underlying intent, not an exact phrase.

name: get_execution_playbook
title: Get a goal-specific, verifiable MCP action plan
